author: Warhammer
description:
Focus Entertainment and Saber Interactive are excited to announce the release of the Techmarine Update for Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2. The gameplay update is available free for all PlayStation 5, Xbox Series, and PC players. Alongside the Techmarine come a new PvE mission, a new weapon, the Raven Guard Champion Pack and Carcharodons Cosmetic Pack for Season Pass 2 owners, and much more. Learn more here https://www.warhammer-community.com/en-gb/articles/jgazn8yc/the-techmarine-class-comes-to-warhammer-40000-space-marine-2-with-a-new-mission-and-cosmetics-in-tow/
